This site is an AI-native portfolio: the chat on the page has read everything
listed below. The sections rendered on the page are hand-authored; the chat's
deeper knowledge is retrieved from a personal knowledge wiki via pgvector.

## Work projects (NDA)

Built at LogoLife. Under NDA: patterns only, no screenshots.

- Athena — React, Express, Vercel AI SDK, Mem0, MCP. An admissions assistant
  that coaches students and remembers each one across sessions. Patterns:
  memory that lasts across sessions, a secure MCP server for live student
  data, and nudges that bring students back.
- AI Web Crawler — Firecrawl, OpenAI GPT-5 mini, text-embedding-3-large,
  Grok 4 Fast, MongoDB Atlas. A five-stage pipeline that searches the web,
  turns pages into records and enriches them. Two dedup layers, one before
  enrichment and one after it, cut enrichment costs by 70%.
